defs.def: with a lot of wind 天气等

ex.s: B: Well, it’s going to be sunny in the morning and not very windy, so I’m having a picnic with my friends.
ex.t: B:嗯，明天早上会很晴朗，但风力不强，所以我要和我的朋友们一起野餐。

ex.s: In front of the classrooms, there was a playground which got dusty on windy days and muddy on rainy days.
ex.t: 教室前面有一个操场，刮风天尘土飞扬，下雨天泥泞不堪。

ex.s: It began in the middle of November on a cold, windy day.I remember the wind because Granny moved in.
ex.t: 它开始于十一月中旬一个寒冷、刮风的日子。我记得那风，因为奶奶那天搬了进来。

ex.s: He thought it was too dangerous for Ian to be alone on such a cold, windy night.
ex.t: 他认为伊恩在这样一个寒冷、刮风的夜晚独自一人太危险了。
